text:
marta: evening handoff — quick watchlist for tonight (non-incident). small noisy signals we saw during the day, FYI:
- encoder-pool: occasional CPU jitter on node group gp-enc-02 (~5% of requests, spikes ~200ms). seen after heavy batching. watching.
- eu-prefetch: prefix cache miss rate drifted ~3% -> 7% around 16:10 UTC, likely due to rolling config push earlier (ttl tweak).
- kv-store: transient 'connection reset by peer' logs in replica-3, ~10/min for 20m, auto-recovered.
- alert: routing-rule-prefetch-timeout fired once at 18:05, noise suspected (flapping probe).
notes: no customer impact observed. can be re-evaluated in morning.

Please monitor these and escalate if SLO impact or repeat spikes. Link to runbook and quick mitigation steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-prefetch-encoder

sheridan: thanks — do we have the exact k8s pod names for encoder-pool jitter so I can tail logs? :eyes:

marta: yes — gp-enc-02-* (three pods). quick tail command:
```
kubectl -n infer logs -f deploy/gp-enc-02 -c encoder --since=10m
```

lee: i'll keep an eye on gp-enc-02 for the first 2h of the shift. if jitter reappears, i'll restart the oldest pod. :thumbsup:

ana: for eu-prefetch drift — is the TTL rollback actionable now or do we want to wait for low traffic? also where's the config push audit? i'm happy to run a quick revert if needed.

marta: good Q. prefer to let it run under low traffic and watch trend for 2 more hours. config push ID: cfg-20260316-ttl-bump — audit here: https://redwood.internal/configs/cfg-20260316-ttl-bump
if it spikes back above 6% we can revert with:
```
redwoodctl config apply --id cfg-previous --env eu
```

oncall-bot: automated note — no open incidents tied to these signals. avg token latency unaffected (p50 unchanged). Added tags: encoder-jitter, eu-prefetch-drift, kv-transient

sheridan: noted. i'll set a short Grafana alert to catch >6% prefetch miss for 10m so we don't miss the window.

marta: appreciated. final FYI — if the routing-rule-prefetch-timeout repeats more than twice in 30m, mute the alert and file a postmortem ticket with diagnostics. leave a note in #incidents if you mute so SRE can review.

lee: got it. ping me in-thread if anything changes — i'll post a quick swap summary at 22:30 UTC. :wave:

marta: thanks team, handing off coverage to lee and sheridan. i'm reachable on pager if needed.
